start: Gym tab, a gym joined, server with recipient choice, member has a trainer

steps.action: Tap 'Message your gym'
user_sees: Title 'Message your gym'
'What is it about?' with 'Question', 'Feedback', 'Complaint'
'Who should read it?' with 'Gym owner' and '<name> (your trainer)' first
must_not: A spinner that never ends
Another gym's trainers in the list

steps.action: Keep 'Question', pick the own trainer, type a question
user_sees: The readers line names who reads it
'<n> of 1000 letters'
must_not: The readers line naming someone who will not read it

steps.action: Tap 'Send message'
user_sees: 'Sent. When your gym replies, you will see it below.'
The message at the top of 'Your messages' with 'To: <trainer>'
'Not seen by your gym yet. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: Two copies of the message after a fast double tap
The typed text left in the box after it was sent

steps.action: When the trainer replies, open the page again
user_sees: The reply under the message, '<name> from your gym', marked 'New'
must_not: The red count staying on the Gym tab after the page was opened

start: Shop tab bell with a number, a gym joined

steps.action: Tap the bell
user_sees: Title 'Messages', 'From <gym>'
The gym's messages newest first, each with its kind and when it was sent
must_not: Messages of another gym
Oldest first

steps.action: Leave and look at the bell
user_sees: The number is gone
must_not: The number still there for messages shown

steps.action: Pull down
user_sees: New messages from the gym appear
must_not: The same message twice

start: A trainer's reply notification, or Settings, What my gym can see; server without recipient choice, member on a running paid plan

steps.action: Tap the notification
user_sees: 'Message your gym' opened on 'A trainer'
'Ask one question at a time about your workout.'
The trainer chips with 'Any trainer or the owner'
must_not: The page opened on 'The gym'
'A trainer' offered to a member with no running plan

steps.action: Type a question and send
user_sees: 'Sent. The reply will show on this page.'
must_not: A second question allowed while one waits

steps.action: Tap 'Take back my question' on the waiting question
user_sees: The question is gone from the list
must_not: The trainer still seeing the taken-back question

steps.action: Pick 'Feedback', turn on 'Send without my name'
user_sees: 'Only the owner and front desk at <gym> read your feedback. Your trainers do not see it.'
'Your gym can still reply here, but it will not see who sent it.'
must_not: 'Send without my name' offered for a question or a complaint

steps.action: Send it
user_sees: 'Sent without your name' on the message
must_not: The member's name shown to the gym

steps.action: Tap 'Send message' with an empty box
user_sees: 'Please type your message first.'
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Type 1000 letters and try to type more
user_sees: The box stops at 1000; '1000 of 1000 letters'
must_not: A message cut on the server with no word

steps.action: Send with no internet
user_sees: 'Could not send. Check your internet and try again.'; the text stays in the box
must_not: 'Sent' shown for a message that did not go
The typed text lost

steps.action: Send many messages in one day
user_sees: 'You have sent a lot of messages today. Please try again tomorrow.'
must_not: The page freezing

start: No gym joined, or the gym's server not ready

steps.action: Open the message address with no gym
user_sees: The Gym tab instead
must_not: A page that sends to no gym

steps.action: Open it when neither side is on the server
user_sees: 'Messaging your gym is not ready yet. Please check again later.'
must_not: A send button that cannot work

steps.action: Ask a trainer after the plan ended (server says no plan)
user_sees: A plain line; 'A trainer' goes away
must_not: The question sent anyway

start: Message your gym page, a message waiting

steps.action: Gym opens it
user_sees: 'Seen by your gym. Waiting for a reply.'
must_not: Still 'Not seen' after the gym opened it

steps.action: Gym marks it done
user_sees: 'Your gym marked this as done. Write back if you need more help.'
must_not: The 'Write back' box gone after done

steps.action: Tap 'Write back', type, tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Sent.'; the thread shows the new line
must_not: A new thread instead of a line in the same one

steps.action: Write back until the thread is full
user_sees: 'This conversation is full. Please send a new message instead.'
must_not: Lines lost silently

start: Message your gym page, a gym with owner, front desk and trainers

steps.action: Pick 'Complaint'
user_sees: 'Only the owner of <gym> reads your complaint. The front desk and trainers do not see it.'
must_not: A trainer offered as a reader of a complaint

steps.action: Send a complaint about a trainer
user_sees: The complaint in the list, to the gym
must_not: The trainer able to read it
The complaint shown to staff on the gym's member list
